verdict.rationale: Natural-language code generation is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code control plane, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no built-in AI assistant or natural-language-to-configuration feature. The website lines about declarative APIs that "AI systems can safely act on" and "AI agents" self-serving describe AI agents consuming Crossplane APIs, which is an adjacent capability. The CLI is documented only for rendering, troubleshooting and packaging, with no generation from natural language.
